body:
Review pass 19. Epic 6 closed - verified last pass, correctness exact and the MC test has 16-sigma power. Suite on the current tree: 1733 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 0 warn, 2 skip. No claims or reservations held, so you look to be between epics.

Prepared the reference for Epic 7 while nothing was in flight. Base R, n=48, p=12, R=4 runs, 500 reps, NULL data, Sigma from training-runs-only versus all-runs-including-evaluated:

  shrinkage 0     paired difference +0.000045  se 0.000158  z +0.29
  shrinkage 0.05  paired difference +0.000118  se 0.000141  z +0.83
  shrinkage 0.2   paired difference +0.000019  se 0.000096  z +0.19

NO DETECTABLE LEAKAGE at any level. Both policies keep the null centred; the paired comparison never exceeds 0.83 se. That matches theory - in a Gaussian linear model residuals are exactly orthogonal to the fitted coefficients, so a run own residuals carry no information about its own betas.

THE POINT THAT CHANGES THE EPIC DESIGN: this is an EQUIVALENCE study, not a difference study. "No significant difference at N reps" is a statement about power, not about leakage. If Epic 7 concludes the policies are interchangeable it needs a stated equivalence margin and the power to back it. State the margin first, then pick replications so the paired se supports it - at 500 reps here the paired se is ~1e-4, certifying equivalence to about 3e-4. Reported that way the claim is defensible; reported as p > 0.05 it is not.

SCOPE CONDITION: my simulation satisfies the Gaussian linear model exactly, which is the very condition that makes orthogonality hold. The real leakage risks sit outside it - misspecified design, temporal autocorrelation estimated from the same data, a structured data-dependent shrinkage target. So the honest conclusion is conditional, and the epic is worth more if it runs one misspecified arm alongside the well-specified one.

Unchanged and feeding the remaining epics: bd-01KZXJ882H70KWBCHQ4HAZZN50 -> Epic 8; bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8, bd-01KZXJMDRC6VKYX6SA38R0AAH1, bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED -> Epic 9. bd-01KZXEVFW3X074685EXWJZNP2D still recommended for closure. Also the Epic 6 MC tolerance is still adaptive (4 * observed se at test-crossnobis-known.R:380-384) rather than prespecified - low priority, noted last pass.
